window_covered: After the US close on Saturday 08 August 2026 through before the US open on Monday 10 August 2026

shortlist.selection_rationale: Stock swung -33% in a month after a short-seller report challenged the structure of its $2.4B power contract; a dense, contested public-filings dispute where careful synthesis of the record can add real value.

Commercial-stage CNS name with three launched drugs (Auvelity/Sunosi/Symbravo) whose revenue trajectory is trackable via prescription data; heavy bull skew (20/21 buys) raises reaction risk on any miss.
Small-cap IP licensor that surged 14% on its last beat; licensing revenue is lumpy and deal-timing driven, but design-win/royalty trend tracking gives a real read on the setup.

High-multiple SaaS name with a live analyst debate over SMB softness vs. enterprise strength (dispersed EPS estimates) and a history of large post-print swings; plenty of public KPI/cohort data to adjudicate it.
Staffing-cost pressure vs. a swing-to-profitability debate ($0.06 consensus EPS) is a real argument to adjudicate via case-volume and margin trackers, with dense public disclosure to work from.
Stock has already jumped 9-12% multiple times this year on guidance raises; guided student-start growth (10-14%) is a trackable KPI that lets research get ahead of the print.

Bitcoin miner pivoting to AI cloud (ARR ~$76M); monthly operating updates reduce surprise on the mining side, leaving AI-cloud monetization and the recent $4.7B AI deal as the genuinely researchable swing factor.
52-week range of $1.17-$7.37 and a projected 55% YoY revenue decline set up a violent print, but the value driver is largely crypto/hashrate sentiment that research can only partly get ahead of.
Small-cap post-merger IoT/fleet name with rapid revenue growth (+45% YoY last print) that can swing hard on prints; thinner analyst coverage and integration noise cap forecastability somewhat.
Israeli semi-metrology name riding HBM/advanced-packaging demand with a disclosed $260M+ order backlog; trackable KPIs and peer read-throughs (KLAC, ASML, memory makers) give genuine synthesis edge.
